definitionZh: 即使是非故意位移，也强制处理程序开火（忽略阈值）。在这种情况下，状态的有意属性将保持为假，直到达到阈值。
sourceDefinition: Forces the handler to fire even for non intentional displacement (ignores the threshold). In that case, the intentional attribute from state will remain false until the threshold is reached.
